title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array
description: Searches for a target value in a sorted array that has been rotated at an unknown pivot, using a modified binary search approach.

steps.note: Initialize 'low' pointer to the start of the array (index 0).
Initialize 'high' pointer to the end of the array (last index).
Start binary search loop: low (0) <= high (6) is true.
Check if nums[mid] (nums[3] = 7) is the target (0). It's not.
Check if the left half (nums[low] to nums[mid]) is sorted: nums[0] (4) <= nums[3] (7) is true.
Target (0) is not within the sorted left half (4 <= 0 is false).
Target must be in the right (potentially unsorted) half. Move 'low' to mid + 1: 3 + 1 = 4.
Continue binary search loop: low (4) <= high (6) is true.
Check if nums[mid] (nums[5] = 1) is the target (0). It's not.
Check if the left half (nums[low] to nums[mid]) is sorted: nums[4] (0) <= nums[5] (1) is true.
Target (0) is within the sorted left half (0 <= 0 is true AND 0 < 1 is true).
Continue binary search loop: low (4) <= high (4) is true.
Check if nums[mid] (nums[4] = 0) is the target (0). It is!
